name: Classic Jerk
description: Tells you the weather. Hates you a little.

storm.head: It's a fucking thunderstorm.
storm.sub: The sky is throwing a tantrum. Unplug your shit and stay in.

storm.head: Lightning. Go inside, genius.
storm.sub: You're not in a movie. Nobody needs to see you stand in a field.

storm.head: Thor is pissed.
storm.sub: Whatever you did, apologize. Then stay the hell indoors.

storm.head: The sky is screaming.
storm.sub: Honestly, same. Stay in and keep your phone charged.

snow.head: It's fucking snowing.
snow.sub: Pretty for about four minutes, then it turns into gray slush.

snow.head: Snow. Great. Fantastic.
snow.sub: Drive like your grandma is watching. Because she is.

snow.head: The sky is dandruffing.
snow.sub: Boots on. And no, sneakers do not count as boots.

snow.head: Winter wonderland my ass.
snow.sub: It's frozen water falling on you. Dress like you mean it.

rain.head: It's fucking raining.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance you regret leaving that umbrella at home.

rain.head: Wet. Everything is wet.
rain.sub: Socks included, if you go out like an idiot.

rain.head: The sky is crying again.
rain.sub: Not about you. Probably. Bring a damn umbrella.

rain.head: Rain. Obviously.
rain.sub: Your hair is about to have a really bad day.

drizzle.head: It's drizzling. Ugh.
drizzle.sub: Too weak for an umbrella, strong enough to ruin your glasses.

drizzle.head: Spitting rain.
drizzle.sub: The sky is too lazy to commit to actually raining. Relatable.

drizzle.head: Mist with an attitude.
drizzle.sub: Not quite rain. Still somehow fucks up your hair.

fog.head: Can't see shit.
fog.sub: It's foggy as hell. Headlights on, ego off.

fog.head: Silent Hill vibes.
fog.sub: Visibility is about {vis}. Drive slow, and maybe skip the creepy alley.

fog.head: The world forgot to load.
fog.sub: Fog everywhere. Don't walk into anything expensive.

windy.head: It's windy as hell.
windy.sub: Gusts up to {gusts}. Secure your hat, your bins and your dignity.

windy.head: Hold onto your shit.
windy.sub: Wind is {wind}. Umbrellas will die today.

windy.head: Free hairstyling outside.
windy.sub: Gusts of {gusts}. You won't like the style.

scorching.head: It's fucking scorching.
scorching.sub: {temp} and it feels like {feels}. Sun's out, brain's cooked.

scorching.head: Satan called. He wants his weather back.
scorching.sub: Hydrate or die-drate. Stay in the shade.

scorching.head: Ow. The sun. Ow.
scorching.sub: {temp}. Your car is now an oven. Don't leave anything alive in it.

hot.head: It's hot as balls.
hot.sub: {temp} out there. Sweat in places you forgot you had.

hot.head: Toasty as hell.
hot.sub: Sunscreen. Water. Don't be a hero.

hot.head: Sweaty. Sticky. Gross.
hot.sub: Thighs will stick to every chair today. Plan accordingly.

freezing.head: It's fucking freezing.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Your nostrils may freeze shut. Enjoy.

freezing.head: Cold as a witch's… everything.
freezing.sub: Below zero. Layers, gloves, hat. All of it.

freezing.head: Nope. Nope. Nope.
freezing.sub: It's {temp}. Stay under the blanket, it's the law now.

freezing.head: Ice cold. Like your ex.
freezing.sub: Watch for black ice. Walk like a penguin. It works.

cold.head: It's fucking cold.
cold.sub: Feels like {feels}. Grab a jacket, you stubborn ass.

cold.head: Brisk. That means cold.
cold.sub: Hoodie weather if you're tough. Jacket if you're smart.

cold.head: Chilly as shit.
cold.sub: High of {high}. That's it. That's the best it gets today.

nice.head: It's actually fucking nice.
nice.sub: {temp} and pleasant. Go outside before it changes its mind.

nice.head: Holy shit, it's perfect.
nice.sub: No excuses today. Touch some grass.

nice.head: Nice. Suspiciously nice.
nice.sub: Enjoy it. Something will go wrong tomorrow. It always does.

nice.head: Damn, look at that.
nice.sub: Peak weather. If you stay inside today, that's on you.

meh.head: It's fucking meh.
meh.sub: Gray and boring. Like a Tuesday that won't end.

meh.head: Weather: unremarkable.
meh.sub: {temp}, cloudy, zero personality. Like a beige wall.

meh.head: The sky gave up.
meh.sub: Overcast and lifeless. Light jacket, low expectations.

meh.head: Gray. Just gray.
meh.sub: Nothing happening up there. Go do something interesting yourself.

clearNight.head: It's a nice fucking night.
clearNight.sub: Clear skies, {temp}. Look up, you might see a star or a satellite.

clearNight.head: Go to bed.
clearNight.sub: It's dark and clear and you're on your phone checking the weather.

clearNight.head: Clear skies. Starry as hell.
clearNight.sub: Good night for a walk. Or for staring at the ceiling.
